title: Design System: Alex Dev — Portfolio (Stitch port)

display.purpose: Hero headline, page H1s, contact-teaser headline — Hanken Grotesk 700.

headline.purpose: Section H2s and card titles — Hanken Grotesk 600.

label.purpose: Nav, buttons, tags, form labels, timeline dates — Geist 500.

shadows.name: ambient-shadow
shadows.purpose: The single elevation shadow used on every card, panel, and the hero portrait frame. No second tier.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered section entrance, via Reveal.jsx + IntersectionObserver. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Gradient Button
components.description: The one CTA style across the site — electric-blue gradient fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-gradient { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: 'Geist', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; color: #ffffff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4b8eff 0%, #005bc1 100%); border-radius: 0.5rem; transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-gradient:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(75,142,255,0.5); }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Translucent, blurred card surface underlying timeline entries, skill/achievement cards, and the contact form.
components.css: .ds-glass-panel { background-color: rgba(30,41,59,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 0.75rem; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); padding: 1.5rem; color: #dae2fd; }

components.name: Project Mosaic Tile
components.description: Home page's featured-work tile — full-bleed image, gradient scrim, overlay text.
components.css: .ds-project-tile { position: relative; border-radius: 0.75rem; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-project-tile-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(11,19,38,0.95), transparent); display: flex; align-items: flex-end; padding: 2rem; }

components.name: Nav
components.description: Fixed, blurred top nav with route-based active underline; anchor-only links never activate.
components.css: .ds-nav { position: fixed; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 5rem; background: rgba(11,19,38,0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #adc6ff; border-bottom: 2px solid #adc6ff; }

components.name: Competency Bar
components.description: On the dedicated /skills page's Core Competencies card: label + percent row, animated fill (0 -> target% on mount) with a primary-container -> primary gradient and a soft glow.
components.html: System Architecture95%
components.css: .ds-competency-track { height: 0.5rem; background: #2d3449; border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-competency-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4b8eff, #adc6ff); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(173,198,255,0.5); transition: width 1s ease-out; }

components.name: Tech Arsenal Card
components.description: On /skills: icon-in-square header + name, then a bulleted item list. The Certifications variant swaps to the secondary (emerald) accent and uses a check-style icon per item instead of a bullet.
components.css: Uses the Glass Panel component above as its base.

components.name: Icon
components.description: Material Symbols Outlined ligature icon, no SVG set.
components.css: .material-symbols-outlined { font-family: 'Material Symbols Outlined'; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; line-height: 1; }

narrative.northStar: Stitch port — dark glassmorphic pro-tool portfolio
narrative.overview: This build replaced an earlier 'System Diagram' whiteboard concept wholesale, at explicit user instruction, with a direct port of a Google Stitch-generated concept ('Elite Professional Digital Portfolio') rebuilt on Tailwind v4. It was not produced through Impeccable's own direction-selection process. The visual identity is a dark, glassmorphic 'pro-tool' aesthetic: deep charcoal/navy surfaces, frosted glass cards, one committed electric-blue gradient accent for CTAs and active state, emerald reserved for a secondary skill-category accent, and one soft ambient shadow used everywhere instead of a tiered shadow system. Content (name, employers, stats, certifications, awards) is Stitch's fictional placeholder copy, kept intentionally as-is per instruction rather than replaced or extended — flagged throughout as needing real material before launch.
keyCharacteristics: Deep charcoal/navy ground, never pure black — a five-step surface-container elevation ladder
One committed electric-blue gradient (#4b8eff -> #005bc1) for every CTA and the one hero gradient-text moment
Emerald and a warm tertiary are narrow secondary/tertiary accents (skill-group and achievement icons only), never co-equal brand colors
Three-typeface role split: Hanken Grotesk display/headline, Inter body, Geist label/UI chrome
Frosted glass panels (backdrop-blur) as the primary card surface; full-bleed photography under gradient scrims for project tiles
One ambient shadow value used everywhere depth is needed — no resting/hover shadow tiers
Material Symbols Outlined ligature font for all icons — zero bundled SVG icon set
Multi-page routing (/, /about, /projects, /projects/:slug, /contact) rather than a single scrolling page with anchor nav

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: The electric-blue gradient is the only gradient fill in the system — reserved for primary CTAs and the one hero gradient-text moment. Other accents (emerald, tertiary, error) stay flat.

rules.name: The Three-Role Rule
rules.body: Hanken Grotesk for display/headline, Inter for body, Geist for label/UI chrome — never swapped.

rules.name: The One-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every elevated surface uses the same ambient-shadow value (0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)). Depth differences come from the surface-container ladder, not a second shadow tier.

dos: Do keep the electric-blue gradient as the only gradient — CTAs and the one hero gradient-text moment.
Do use the single ambient-shadow value for every elevated surface.
Do hold the three-typeface split: Hanken Grotesk display/headline, Inter body, Geist label.
Do use rounded-xl on cards/images and rounded-lg on buttons/inputs.
Do key skill-group bar/chip color off the group's own accent field in src/data/site.js.
donts: Don't add a second CTA gradient or a second shadow tier.
Don't replace the Material Symbols icon font with an SVG icon library.
Don't treat the placeholder content (name, employers, stats, certifications) as real.
